subject: Renewal: attestation window, audit logs retention, and capacity uplift
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@skywardhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: attestation window, audit logs retention, and capacity uplift

Hi Emma,

Hope you’re doing well — quick note on the upcoming renewal for Skyward Health (term ends 2026-10-31). Two items came out of internal prep that I wanted to surface early so we can avoid any last-minute friction with procurement and your auditors:

1) SOC 2 re-attestation evidence: we can deliver the standard evidence bundle, but want to confirm timing for your auditor’s evidence request window so Monica (cc’d) can stage uploads. I attached the current SOC2 scope for reference.

2) Audit log retention: you mentioned 12 months previously — can you confirm if the auditor requires longer retention (e.g., 18 months)? We have an S3-archive retention option if needed.

3) Capacity uplift: based on recent usage spikes we recommend a 20% reserved capacity uplift (Dedicated-style pool) to avoid throttling during inference bursts. Happy to bundle as a renewal amendment if that helps procurement.

Next steps: can you confirm the auditor availability and whether procurement needs a formal amendment/DocuSign? If so I’ll prepare a mutual action plan and a pricing addendum.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: SOC2-Scope-2026.pdf
From: Emma Liu <emma@skywardhealth.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@skywardhealth.com>; Midtown Audit <audit@midtown-audit.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: attestation window, audit logs retention, and capacity uplift

Hi Ben — thanks for the heads up. Quick answers: 

- Renewal date is 2026-10-31 and yes, we need the SOC 2 evidence packet by 2026-10-18 for Midtown Audit to start fieldwork the week of Oct 19.
- Midtown Audit has asked us to retain authentication & admin audit logs for 18 months due to a recent compliance review. Can Redwood support 18 months? If it’s an add-on cost, procurement will need the delta.
- We are evaluating Dedicated capacity for steady-state production in Q1 2027. Please include a pricing option for a 20% reserved uplift and a 12-month vs 24-month term comparison.

Cc’ing procurement and the auditor so they can flag requirements.

Best,
Emma Liu
Head of Platform Ops | Skyward Health
emma@skywardhealth.com

Date: 2026-10-05T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: attestation window, audit logs retention, and capacity uplift

Thanks Emma — perfect, that timeline helps.

Monica / Lauren — looping you both in: below is Emma’s ask (quoted). Monica, can you confirm evidence delivery schedule and whether we can stage uploads to meet an Oct 18 cutoff? Lauren, can you prepare: (a) cost delta to extend audit log retention from 12 -> 18 months, and (b) pricing for a 20% reserved capacity uplift with both 12- and 24-month term options.

Quote: 
> Midtown Audit has asked us to retain authentication & admin audit logs for 18 months due to a recent compliance review. Can Redwood support 18 months? If it’s an add-on cost, procurement will need the delta.

Ben (internal note): I think we can offer the 18-month retention as an add-on (S3 archive + retrieval window). If procurement signs a 12-month renewal plus the 20% uplift we can attach a modest one-time onboarding credit to sweeten the 12-month commit. Lauren — is that feasible from a commercial perspective?

Thanks all,
Ben
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Emma Liu <emma@skywardhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@skywardhealth.com>, Midtown Audit <audit@midtown-audit.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T11:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: attestation window, audit logs retention, and capacity uplift

Hi team — Monica from Customer Success here. I put together a short evidence & retention plan that fits the Oct 18 cutoff: 

Evidence upload plan (high level):
- Oct 07–10: We’ll create a dedicated evidence folder and pre-populate with control mappings, policy docs, and system diagrams. (Attachment: evidence-upload-playbook.pdf)
- Oct 11–15: Upload transactional logs, access reviews, and change-control artifacts. We’ll produce CSV extracts of admin/auth logs for the last 18 months.
- Oct 16–18: Auditor access & final handoff; Monica will run checks and deliver a verification checklist.

Retention options for audit logs: 
- Standard: 12 months (default, no charge)
- Extended: 18 months via S3 Glacier/Archive + search index pre-warm — incremental monthly: USD 0.03 per GB/month (est. 75GB/mo = ~USD 2.25/mo). One-time retrieval configuration fee USD 750. (See attached log-retention-config-steps.txt and the rough cost estimate Lauren is attaching.)

Capacity uplift recommendation: we can reserve a Dedicated pool with a 20% baseline buffer. If you commit 12 months we can offer 10% off the uplift line-item; 24 months we can go to 18% off and include a one-time migration engineering session. Lauren attached the sku/pricing CSV.

Deliverables attached: evidence-upload-playbook.pdf, log-retention-config-steps.txt, ram-upgrade-sku-pricing.csv, mutual-action-plan-Skyward.docx

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Renewal amendment & next steps (DocuSign + delivery milestones)

Emma / Procurement — thanks for the fast turnaround. Quick summary and proposed next steps so everything is explicit for procurement and your auditor: 

Agreed items:
- Evidence delivery: Redwood to deliver evidence bundle and staged uploads by 2026-10-18 (Monica lead).
- Log retention: Skyward elects Extended 18-month retention. Monthly delta and one-time config fee outlined in attachments.
- Capacity: 20% reserved capacity uplift. Pricing options attached for 12- and 24-month terms.

Commercials & paperwork:
- I’ve uploaded the mutual action plan and a pricing addendum into the Drive folder and prepared a short amendment for signature. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123-redwood-amend
- Next milestones:
  - Oct 07: Procurement confirms preferred term (12 vs 24 months) — please reply to this thread.
  - Oct 11: Redwood to begin evidence upload.
  - Oct 18: Auditor kickoff.
  - Oct 31: Term renewal effective date.

Please reply with term preference and we’ll send the amendment to procurement today. If procurement needs a PO-first flow we can do a countersigned amendment + PO net-30.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
